author: Unreal Engine
description:
Watch this video to explore how Liquid Swords is using Unreal Engine to develop gritty, open-world action game ‘Samson’.

‘Samson’ is a character-driven action adventure set in Tyndalston, a city with a long memory and bad habits it can’t shake. 

You play Samson McCray, a former enforcer returning home with a massive debt after a heist goes wrong.  Every punch, crash, and choice matters as systems collide, consequences stack, and the clock keeps ticking. 

Discover the UE5 tools that helped bring the game to life. 

Read the full interview here: https://epic.gm/dev-interviews-samson

Find out more about creating games in Unreal Engine here: unrealengine.com/uses/games
